name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B (instruction-tuned)
purpose: MoE member of Gemma 4 for reasoning, coding, agentic workflows and image understanding at 3.8 B active parameters.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Gemma 4 repos carry no LICENSE file; the card links ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma_4_license, which redirects to gemma.ai/resources/apache-2/ (Google DeepMind, read through a summarizer 2026-11-19): plain Apache License 2.0 text ('perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable' grant), no Gemma-specific terms and no prohibited-use policy. The older Gemma Terms of Use (Gemma 1-3, TranslateGemma) are a different, restrictive text.

architecture.kind: MoE, hybrid local/global attention, vision encoder
architecture.attention: sliding window 1024 interleaved with global layers (last global), p-RoPE
architecture.why_this_design: Card: the 'A4B' MoE activates only 4B of 26B parameters per token, so it 'runs much faster than its 26B total might suggest'. Card: hybrid attention interleaves local sliding-window with full global attention (final layer always global) to 'deliver the processing speed and low memory footprint of a lightweight model without sacrificing the deep awareness required for complex, long-context tasks'.

pc-16gb.variant: UD-Q4_K_M 17 GB, small spill to RAM

engine_support.notes: No Gemma 4 module in Tona (ArchId list: Qwen4Exp, Qwen35Moe, NemotronHMoe).

strengths: Large vendor score per active parameter (MMLU-Pro 82.6 at 3.8 B active)
Apache-2.0; 5.1 M downloads of the GGUF per research/52
weaknesses: Long-context retrieval weak (MRCR 44.1 against 66.4 for the 31B)
Local tool-calling problems: <unused24> token flood in llama.cpp (issue 22786), one harness looped 2,300 calls on a missing tool, less proactive deep search than Qwen 3.5 27B for one user
Gradual KV-cache growth across turns reported for the 26B and 31B
soft.behavior: Same thinking switch as the 31B (<|think|> in the system prompt); T=1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64.
best_for: Fast general chat and image questions on 16-24 GB
avoid_for: Long agentic tool loops until the template and parser issues settle

user_reports.summary: llama.cpp issue: the 26B-A4B emits an unbounded stream of <unused24> tokens mid-response.
UD_Q4_K_XL on llama.cpp main was much less proactive at deep searches than Qwen 3.5 27B; tool-calling inconsistencies in local deployments.

soft.maturity: Google DeepMind; chat-template fixes landed in an Unsloth update of 2026-04-11 (search summary).

tona_fit.reason: Fast MoE (4B active) that fits 16 GB-class machines, Apache-2.0 (text read), independent German MMLU-ProX 78.2 and MuSR 83.7 are close to the 31B dense. Unresolved local tool-calling reports (llama.cpp) keep it behind the Qwen 35B-A3B class for agent use; the missing Tona module is only a blocker.
blockers: no Gemma 4 MoE module in Tona
